vswr.title: VSWR Calculator

vswr.reflectedExceed: Reflected power cannot exceed forward power.

gain.title: Gain Calculator

gain.enterDbValues: Enter dB values to add (positive for gain, negative for loss).
gain.validBothPowers: Enter valid numeric values for both powers.
gain.atLeastOneDb: Enter at least one dB value.
gain.allValidNumbers: All values must be valid numbers.

transformer.title: Transformer Calculator
transformer.description: Calculate turns ratio, voltages, currents, and impedance
transformer.enterVoltages: Enter primary and secondary voltages to calculate turns ratio.
transformer.enterTurns: Enter number of turns to calculate ratio and voltage relationship.

transformer.validVoltages: Enter valid numeric values for both voltages.
transformer.validTurns: Enter valid numeric values for both turn counts.

BecomeHam.title: How to become a ham radio operator
BecomeHam.intro: In Portugal, the process to become a licensed ham radio operator is regulated by ANACOM (National Communications Authority) and involves several steps and categories. This guide will explain the process from the beginning to obtaining the most advanced license.
BecomeHam.categoriesIntro: There are three categories for new ham radio operators in Portugal, organized progressively:
BecomeHam.category3PowerFootnote: *A Category 3 license holder may use stations of higher category amateurs, under their supervision, in transmission and reception modes, using the frequency bands permitted to them. - DL 53/2009 - Article 8
BecomeHam.approval: Approval: Score at least 50% of the questions.
BecomeHam.waitTimesNote: These are minimum wait times. Many ham radio operators choose to spend more time in each category to gain experience before progressing.

registration.title: Register with ANACOM
registration.description: Access the ANACOM portal, fill out the registration form and pay the exam fee. You'll receive email confirmation with the exam date and location.

preparation.title: Prepare for the exam
preparation.description: Study the official syllabus using our materials, exam simulations and flashcards. Also consider joining courses from local amateur radio clubs.

exam.title: Take the exam
exam.description: Arrive at the ANACOM designated location with your ID document. The exam is multiple choice and you have limited time to answer all questions.

results.title: Results and callsign
results.description: Results are communicated on the same day. If approved, you receive your official callsign and can start operating according to your category.

maintenance.compliance: Compliance with regulations and good practices of amateur radio.
